latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of component-generator — generate video components from uploaded footage via cloud AI.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files up to 500MB for automatic AI component generation
- Instantly create intro, outro, and lower-third video components without manual editing
- Cloud-based rendering: returns finished, downloadable video files (up to 1080p MP4) in 30–90 seconds
- Tracks credits, handles session setup, and guides through upload, export, and state management
- Includes concise prompt-based workflow, error handling, and easy credit management for fast results
